title: Thermometer Gun Aapki Roshni Padhti Hai 👀 #shorts
description:
Bina chhue thermometer aapka temperature kaise napta hai? Chaliye infrared ka poora raaz 3D mein dekhte hain.
🌡️ Skin se nikalti invisible infrared aur thermopile ka kaam
🔦 FC-51 module kaise khud IR beam bhejta hai
⚡ Photodiode ke andar electrons aur chhota current
🧠 LM393 comparator aur blue pot ki range setting
🔌 Module ko Arduino se jodna
Aise aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo.
